sourceAuthority: Verified successful formal read/preview result only
ledgerRule: The ledger projects producer values and never computes readiness, shortage, coverage, procurement quantities, or cost.

binding.resolvedMaterial: Internal partId/coilId binds the fact to the exact formal Part/Coil; model-facing catalog shows canonical name but hides numeric ID.
binding.requirementRef: Result-scoped grouping reference binds required/available/shortage facts without creating a database Requirement entity.
binding.unresolved: Missing canonical identity or missing required quantity remains explicit and never becomes zero or a resolved shortage.

validation.quantity: Claim value, quantity role, unit and named entity must match cited formal facts.
validation.collection: Claims using complete/all language require cited COMPLETE formal collection evidence.
validation.noShortage: No-shortage language requires a formal READY readiness fact plus complete collection evidence.
validation.crossDomain: The ledger does not infer whether purchase quantity covers a shortage.
